howTo.heading: How to read the sky dome

cards.title: Zenith & horizon
cards.body: The centre of the dome is the zenith — directly overhead. The outer edge is the horizon. Objects near the centre are high in the sky; objects near the edge are near the horizon.

cards.title: North is up
cards.body: The dome is oriented with North at the top, East to the right, South at the bottom, and West to the left — matching a sky chart held overhead.

cards.title: Ecliptic path
cards.body: The golden arc shows the ecliptic — the apparent path of the Sun through the year. All planets travel near this line, which is why they are always found in the zodiac constellations.

cards.title: Faded objects
cards.body: Planets and stars shown faded are currently below the horizon. They are still plotted so you can see where they will rise and how the sky will look in a few hours.

planets.sun: The Sun represents your core identity, vitality, and conscious will. Its position shows where you shine.
planets.moon: The Moon governs emotions, instincts, and the subconscious. It moves fastest of all planets.
planets.mercury: Mercury rules communication, thought, and travel. It is never far from the Sun.
planets.venus: Venus governs love, beauty, and values. It appears as the brightest planet in the sky.
planets.mars: Mars rules drive, ambition, and action. Its red hue has inspired warriors across cultures.
planets.jupiter: Jupiter brings expansion, wisdom, and good fortune. The largest planet in our solar system.
planets.saturn: Saturn teaches discipline, structure, and karma. Its rings symbolise boundaries and time.
planets.uranus: Uranus governs revolution, innovation, and awakening. It rotates on its side.
planets.neptune: Neptune rules dreams, mysticism, and the dissolving of boundaries.
planets.pluto: Pluto governs transformation, death, and rebirth. Tiny but profoundly powerful.
